text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Trainer. ♪ Ahhh, I'm feeling
real good
today.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I slept so well last night I can hardly
believe it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I washed my cat plushie too, and
now it's
fluffy as a little cloud.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's soft belly was the perfect pillow to
let me
sleep like a baby.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then I dreamed I was sleeping all
snuggled up
with a real cat.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm bursting with kitty power
today. ♪
choice_data_list: You went to sleep in your dream too...?
